Nikhil / Kim —

If Wed 9/16 13:00 PDT is the slot, I can cover the technical walkthrough. Proposed 45-minute run of show:
- 0–5m: Introductions & objectives (AE)
- 5–20m: High-level architecture + data flow (SE) — include runtime segmentation and KV cache behavior for PII/non-PII
- 20–35m: Security controls & evidence (Security) — encryption at rest/in transit, KMS, tenant isolation, audit logs and retention
- 35–45m: Open Q&A & next steps (procurement cadence / pilot checklist)

Suggested artifacts I’ll bring: runtime-arch-v2.png (diagram), short notes on telemetry (token-level logs), example retention policy snippet, and our SOC2 summary. For production pilots we typically also provide a network/port list and a minimal data processing addendum.

I’ll prepare the architecture slide and pass to Kim for the security slide.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: runtime-arch-v2.png (diagram)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@greenfield.ai>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@greenfield.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Greenfield secops session + procurement checklist

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks for confirming Wed 9/16 13:00 PDT. Quick clarifications so we come prepared:
- Scope: please confirm whether this is a POC (test data) or expected to touch production datasets. If production, share data categories (PII, PHI, anonymized) so we can bring the right dataflow diagram.
- Evidence: we will provide our SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, sample retention policy, and an audit-log export example. If you need the full SOC2 report or an on-site audit discussion we can arrange an NDA + SOC2 bridge schedule. See attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf.
- NDA: If Greenfield requires a mutual NDA before sharing environment screenshots we are happy to route a one-page mutual NDA.

Agenda tweak: we’ll reserve 10 minutes at the end to surface any contractual asks procurement has (SLA, data residency, termination/return of data). If procurement prefers not to join live, procurement questions can be captured and routed to our commercial team.

I’ll join the meeting and cover: encryption/KMS design, role-based access, and audit & retention posture.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
